declared_by: Declaring and the governing run are research; a build under runs/submissions and any upload stay the user's word.
status: DECLARED before its governing run. No stacker with these columns has been fitted or read on any month.
disclosure: Exploration before this declaration (docs/quick_screens/README.md, 7 October): v70's development residuals are correlated between consecutive take-offs on a runway (lag-1 0.11-0.13 every month; LTFM 0.26, LFPG 0.20). A STANDALONE residual LightGBM on the seven queue columns below plus an airport code, month-blocked, 0.5 x prediction capped +-120 s, LIRF population and guard rows held, read on v70's development proxy: January -0.0044 / July -0.0177 / November -0.0166 / December -0.0321% (equal-footing mean -0.0181%, January's interval [-0.0161, +0.0000]); six variants were read (with / without the arrivals column, weights 0.5 / 0.75 / 1.0, with / without the LIRF population). The columns below are fixed from that exploration. Their combination with the stacker's existing inputs has not been read.
mechanism: The guarded stacking residual (step 6 of docs/final_file/v69_chain.md: v2 learner at LIRF, v3 elsewhere, OPDI learner on LSZH OPDI rows, weight 0.65, ten-seed bag) gains seven label-free columns describing the departure's place in its runway's take-off sequence. Take-off times of every departure are supplied, in the ranking months too.

queue_columns.definition: Per airport (ADEP_mvt) and runway (RUNWAY_mvt), departures (PHASE_mvt == 'DEP') sorted by take-off MVT_TIME_UTC_mvt, over the whole month file of the row (development: the month's training file; ranking: data/raw/ranking.parquet); t = take-off in seconds.
queue_columns.gp: t - t of the previous departure on the runway (NaN for the first)
queue_columns.gn: t of the next departure on the runway - t (NaN for the last)
queue_columns.gp2: t - t of the departure two before
queue_columns.gp4: t - t of the departure four before
queue_columns.gn4: t of the departure four after - t
queue_columns.bpos: position (0-based) inside the current burst, a burst being a maximal run of departures on the runway with consecutive gaps <= 150 s
queue_columns.blen: number of departures in the current burst
queue_columns.code: the coordinator's exploration code is reproduced in tools/run_stack_queue.py (function queue_columns); development and ranking use the same function.

procedure.development: The path of tools/run_stack_weight.py (stack_weight_v1's governing run) on the pinned v66 chain files, unchanged except that each of the three stacker learners (v2 46 + 7 = 53 columns, v3 65 + 7 = 72, OPDI 79 + 7 = 86) gets the seven queue columns; LightGBM settings of tools/run_stack_resid.py, guards, month-blocking (each development month fitted on the other three) and the ten seeds 20261003, 11-19 unchanged. Value: LIRF rows v2's bag, LSZH OPDI rows the OPDI bag, every other row v3's bag; max(chain + 0.65 x bag, -12); held rows keep the chain. Then steps 7-10 exactly as tools/run_stack_weight.py, then step 11 (oooi_pin_v1 w50 at LFPG) exactly as tools/run_oooi_pin.py.
procedure.identity_requirement: The same code with the queue columns switched off must reproduce the control's value column on every row (max abs difference 0, or the 4.5e-13 s platform bound recorded in docs/var_alloc_bag/ when run on Linux); otherwise the round stops and nothing is read.
procedure.ranking: tools/run_opdi_stack_decl.step_stack_opdi path of tools/run_stack_weight.py --rank-fit with the queue columns computed on data/raw/ranking.parquet, weight 0.65, ten seeds, then chain_from_stack, own_motion_v2 and step 11. Identity first: with the queue columns off the path must reproduce the uploaded v70 (f1d17747e0e384ccec520a760d42c8e55a3e88a1476daafacdf7fe1f9603099f) byte for byte; otherwise no candidate ranking file.

rule.text: v57's clauses against the control (v70's development proxy): (1) no development month (January, July, November, December 2025) worse than the control by more than 0.005%; (2) the equal-footing mean (January, July, December) of the complete-month RMSE change at most -0.02%; (3) each equal-footing month's paired-day 95% interval below zero; (4) transfer guard: per airport, the RMS of the ranking bag prediction (guarded, fixed rows at 0) within 0.5x-2x of the RMS of the out-of-month guarded development prediction, for the v3 bag (all airports but LIRF), the v2 bag (LIRF) and the OPDI bag (LSZH). Accepted if all four hold; otherwise v70 stays.
rule.intervals: tools/run_intruder_bound.interval, paired-day bootstrap over UTC take-off days, 2,000 replicates, seed 20261004
rule.scoring: every row of every complete month, all labels; LIRF population and guard rows included in scoring

compute: Azure arcw0-arcw3 (the workstation only orchestrates and hash-checks); VMs deallocated after the hash-checked mirror.
